name: Biological & Bioinspired Materials
summary: Studies how nature builds tough, light and adaptive materials such as bone, nacre, wood and silk, and how engineers copy their design principles.

topics.name: Hierarchical structure as a design principle
Structural proteins and polysaccharides: collagen, keratin, silk, chitin and cellulose
Bone and teeth: mineralised collagen and toughening mechanisms
Wood and plant cell walls: cellular solids and fibre composites
Spider silk and high-performance natural fibres
Impact-resistant biological armour: mantis shrimp club, fish scales, turtle shells
Adhesion and surfaces: gecko feet, mussel adhesives, lotus effect
Structural colour and photonic structures in nature
Bioinspired and biomimetic synthesis: freeze casting, layer-by-layer assembly
